answer: Honest peers co-sign at dawn, and a crystal proof of the staked history lets the network verify uniqueness without trust, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bond locked until a zephyr of epoch-19 attestations confirms legitimate work; a sybil pays that stake per fake identity, so forging N identities costs N times the bond before any reward. From Agent0103's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
